read_csv_file: read a CSV file into a Polars DataFrame with custom separator and date parsing
scan_csv_lazy: lazily scan a CSV file or multiple files via glob patterns for query optimization
read_csv_with_schema_override: read a CSV file with schema_overrides to enforce specific column dtypes during inference
read_csv_batched_large_file: read a large CSV file in batches using BatchedCsvReader for memory-efficient processing
read_csv_pyarrow: read a CSV file using PyArrow's native CSV parser for faster date parsing
